diffs.diff: header pin 3: part says RXD, datasheet reading says RXD/SDA
diffs.evidence: Benewake SJ-PM-TFmini-S A01 Product Manual, Table 5: "③ White RXD/SDA Receiving/Data". This is the same physical pin (pin 3, white wire); it is RXD in UART mode and SDA only in I2C mode. Section 2.1: "compatible with both the UART and I2C interface. Different interfaces can be switched by commands." Table 12, Communication interface setup (5A 05 0A MODE SU): "0 (UART) 1 (I2C)", default setting "UART". The model is interface: uart (115200 8N1, Table 6), so naming the pin by its UART function RXD is correct for the shipped default; pin position, wire colour and role (io) all match.

diffs.diff: header pin 4: part says TXD, datasheet reading says TXD/SCL
diffs.evidence: Same manual, Table 5: "④ Green TXD/SCL Transmitting/Clock". Pin 4 is TXD in the default UART mode (Table 12 default communication interface = UART; Table 6 UART 115200 baud) and SCL only after switching to I2C by command. The model is a UART-mode model, so TXD (pin 4, green wire, io) is the correct name; position and role match.

diffs.diff: distance_cm: datasheet reading gives 1 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: Manual section 5.4: "Dist(Distance): Represents the output of the distance value detected by TFmini-S, with the unit in cm by default." Table 7: Byte2 Dist_L / Byte3 Dist_H. The model does encode 1 cm per count: part.json sim.uartStream bytes 2-3 are {control: value, bits 16, scale 1, littleEndian: true} with unit cm, and the driver computes dist = f[2] | (f[3] << 8) in cm. The gate reports 'none' only because it reads conversions from sim.measure/measures/responses and not from sim.uartStream; the value itself agrees (1 cm/count, offset 0).
